interface.signature: def morganAndString(a: str, b: str) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in a) and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in b)
preconditions.description: Both input strings `a` and `b` contain only uppercase letters (A-Z).
Both input strings `a` and `b` are non-empty (1 ≤ |a|, |b| ≤ 10^5).

postconditions.description: The returned string uses all letters from both stacks `a` and `b` exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in a or return_value[i] in b for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: Every character in the returned string is taken from either `a` or `b` (order preserved by stack top).

postconditions.expression: not any(return_value[:i+1] < return_value[:j+1] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i+1, len(return_value)) if return_value[i] == return_value[j] and return_value[:i] == return_value[:j])
postconditions.description: The returned string is lexicographically minimal among all possible valid strings formed by interleaving `a` and `b` in stack order.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == a[i] for i in range(len(a))) if len(b) == 0 else all(return_value[i] == b[i] for i in range(len(b))) if len(a) == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If one stack is empty, the returned string is the other stack (edge case).
